data.name: Manduboon
data.gender_notes: Manduboon is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'ndb', meaning 'to help'. The name Manduboon signifies one who is supportive and helpful. The name Manduboon carries the meaning “Helpful, Supportive” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Manduboon usually hope their child will grow to embody helpful, supportive and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Manduboon belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Helpful, Supportive.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Manduboon total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.
